title: Machine learning for risk prediction of acute kidney injury in patients with diabetes mellitus combined with heart failure during hospitalization.
summary: The primary study uses six ML algorithms on 1,457 ICU patients to predict AKI in a defined diabetic-heart-failure population and identifies risk factors; it is a single-center retrospective model without external validation, so no clinical benefit is established.
